title: PTK workers protest outside the Kosovo Government over frozen accounts and unpaid salaries
location: In front of the Kosovo Government, Pristina
crowd_size_evidence: Hundreds reported; body does not supply an exact integer.

occurrence_and_date.value: AA reports PTK workers protested on Nov 16; report updated Nov 17.

location.value: In front of the Government of the Republic of Kosovo, Pristina.

attendance.value: Hundreds reported; body does not supply an exact integer.

state_targeted_demand.value: Workers call on Government to unblock accounts/return funds and address unpaid salaries; report links freeze to a private company debt and arbitration judgment.

episode_and_continuity.value: One Nov 16 public protest; article mentions threatened strike and earlier account-block date Oct 26. Follow-up/termination beyond the same date remains unverified.

source_dependence.value: AA is accessible body source; other searched items include 403 and result metadata; no assumed independence.

decision_note: AA body describes hundreds of employees of the public postal/telecom company protesting at the Government and asking it to act over frozen accounts and unpaid wages. A direct state target is reported, but the immediate account freeze arose from a private arbitration debt and the boundaries between public-policy demand and corporate dispute need reviewer assessment. Same-origin translations/republishes are not counted as independent corroboration; attempts to access other exact reports returned 403.
